title: 第9章 收割水灵米第10章 炼气后期碧波无痕术
content_zh:
李衍道毫不推辞，将灵石稳稳收入囊中。
眼下的他，所饲养的金香灵鱼皆处于一阶中期境界，要想让它们进阶至一阶后期，前路漫漫，尚需一番时日。
目前，他只能选择苦修，然而，倘若有了灵石相助，可使他在短短一年之内便有望冲击炼气后期的境界。
“感谢爷爷厚爱，有了这些灵石，一年之内突破瓶颈当非难事。”
爷孙二人目光交汇，彼此间的心意尽在不言中，笑容温暖而深沉。
待李松鹤离去之后，李衍道小心翼翼地将胧香鱼鱼苗安置于水衍珠之内。
相较之下，胧香鱼的照料远比金香灵鱼来得简便许多。
这种鱼类对于生长环境的要求并不苛刻。
不论是二十度左右的温度，亦或是高达三十度或低至十几度的极端条件，它们均能顽强生存，只是生长速度会因温度的不同而有所变化罢了。
至于那些栖身于水衍珠中的灵鱼，水衍珠自动调节出最适合生长的温度与环境，令他无需过多操心。
他只需按照既定的时间节点，定期投放灵米以供鱼儿食用。
李衍道轻车熟路地抓起十几把水灵米，洒向波光粼粼的海面，随后便念头一动返回了自己的阁楼。
步入室内，他缓缓落座于柔软的蒲团之上，开始了抱元守一的修行姿势。
他神情肃穆，从怀中取出一颗灵石，置于掌心，随即闭目凝神，开始炼化其中蕴含的精纯灵气。
不多时，他周身便被一层淡淡的莹莹绿光所笼罩，仿佛置身于一片灵雾之中，进入了深层次的修炼状态。
时光悄无声息地流逝，转眼间便是五个月过去。
此时正值年终岁尾，又到了一年一度的水灵米收割时节。
在这段时间里，李衍道每日坚持炼化一颗灵石，至今已消耗了百余颗之多。
其修为也因此突飞猛进，丹田内的灵力充盈，已达半满之境。
只待灵力蓄满，他便可着手扩张丹田，进而增加其容量，容纳更多灵气，自然而然地迈入练气后期的门槛。

这一天，李衍道与族人——李林燕、李衍云以及李松鹤，一同出现在三亩灵田之中。
他们各自施展灵力，凝聚成锋利的灵刃，迅速而精准地收割着成熟的灵稻。
随后，他们将灵稻整齐地铺放在垫子上，轻轻拍打使灵米脱离稻秆，再运用火属性法术“烘干术”将灵米烘干，最后小心翼翼地装入麻袋中。
整个过程耗时良久，直至夜幕降临，他们才完成了这一年的收割工作，足足耗费了整整一日的时间。
当众人抹去额头上辛勤的汗水，注视着身前摆放着的六个沉甸甸的麻袋，每个人的脸上都洋溢着无法抑制的笑容。
李衍道负责的一亩灵田，如今的水灵米产量已经达到了惊人的八百斤，而其余两人的灵田则各有两百斤的收成。
六个麻袋合计，共装载了一千两百斤的珍贵灵米。
若按市场行情计算，一块灵石大约可换得二十多斤的灵米，如此算来，这批灵米的价值相当于五十多块灵石。
扣除用于维持蕴灵阵运行所需的五块灵石，以及购买灵种的六块灵石，这三亩灵田一年的纯收益达到了四十多块灵石。
content_en:
Li Yandao did not hesitate and firmly pocketed the spirit stone.
At the moment, the Golden Fragrance Spirit Fish he raises are all in the middle stage of the first level. It will take some time for them to advance to the late first level.
At present, he can only choose to practice hard. However, with the help of spiritual stones, he can hope to reach the late stage of Qi refining in just one year.
"Thank you grandpa for your love. With these spiritual stones, it will be easy to break through the bottleneck within a year."
The eyes of the grandfather and grandson met, their feelings for each other were unspoken, and their smiles were warm and deep.
After Li Songhe left, Li Yandao carefully placed the agarfish fry in the water bead.
In comparison, the care of the long-flavored fish is much simpler than that of the golden-flavored fish.
This kind of fish does not have strict requirements for the growth environment.
Whether it is a temperature of about 20 degrees, or extreme conditions as high as 30 degrees or as low as ten degrees, they can survive tenaciously, but their growth rate will vary depending on the temperature.
As for the spiritual fish living in the water beads, the water beads automatically adjust the temperature and environment that are most suitable for growth, so they don't have to worry too much.
He only needs to regularly release spiritual rice for the fish to eat according to the established time points.
Li Yandao grabbed a dozen handfuls of water rice with ease, sprinkled it on the sparkling sea, and then returned to his attic with a sudden thought.
Entering the room, he slowly sat down on the soft futon and began to practice in the posture of holding Yuan Shouyi.
With a solemn expression, he took out a spiritual stone from his arms, placed it in his palm, then closed his eyes and concentrated, and began to refine the pure spiritual energy contained in it.
Not long after, his whole body was enveloped in a faint layer of sparkling green light, as if he was in a spiritual mist and entered a deep state of cultivation.
Time passed quietly, and five months passed in the blink of an eye.
It’s the end of the year, and it’s the annual Shuiling rice harvest season.
During this period of time, Li Yandao insisted on refining one spiritual stone every day, and has consumed more than a hundred of them so far.
As a result, his cultivation level has improved by leaps and bounds, and the spiritual energy in his Dantian has reached half-full level.
As soon as his spiritual energy is fully charged, he can start to expand his Dantian, thereby increasing its capacity to accommodate more spiritual energy, and naturally enter the threshold of the later stage of Qi training.
On this day, Li Yandao and his clan members—Li Linyan, Li Yanyun, and Li Songhe—appeared in the three-acre spiritual field.
They each exerted their spiritual power and condensed it into sharp spiritual blades, harvesting the mature spiritual rice quickly and accurately.
Then, they laid the spiritual rice neatly on the mat, patted it gently to separate the spiritual rice from the rice stalks, and then used the fire-attribute magic "drying technique" to dry the spiritual rice, and finally carefully put it into sacks.
The whole process took a long time, and it was not until night fell that they completed the harvest for the year, which took a full day.
When everyone wiped the sweat from their hard work on their foreheads and stared at the six heavy sacks placed in front of them, everyone's face was filled with uncontrollable smiles.
The output of the one acre of spiritual fields that Li Yandao is responsible for has now reached an astonishing 800 kilograms of water spirit rice, while the other two's spiritual fields each have a harvest of 200 kilograms.
The six sacks in total contained a total of 1,200 kilograms of precious spiritual rice.
If calculated according to market conditions, one spiritual stone can be exchanged for approximately twenty kilograms of spiritual rice. Based on this calculation, the value of this batch of spiritual rice is equivalent to more than fifty spiritual stones.
After deducting the five spiritual stones needed to maintain the operation of the Yunling Array and the six spiritual stones used to purchase spiritual seeds, the net income from these three acres of spiritual land in one year reached more than forty spiritual stones.
